name: read
description: Read text lines or a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image from a file. Text comes back as it is in the file, without line numbers. A successful read allows edits to the file in this session until the file changes. A large image is scaled down. PDF and notebook files are not supported.
guidance: Use read to examine files instead of cat or sed.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or from the working directory.

offset.description: Line to start from, counted from 1. Omit to start at the first line.

limit.description: Number of lines to read. Omit for {read_default_lines}.
